title: Toward solvent-free continuous-flow electrochemically mediated carbon capture with high-concentration liquid quinone chemistry

compounds.name: 2,3-Di-(2-(2-methoxyethoxy)ethoxy)-1,4-naphthoquinone
compounds.quote: 2,3-Di-(2-(2-methoxyethoxy)ethoxy)-1,4-naphthoquinone was synthesized according to a previous report inside a nitrogen-filled glovebox.

conditions.quote: redox behavior in propylene carbonate (PC) with 0.1 M tetrabutylammonium hexafluorophosphate (TBAPF6) as supporting salt under both N2 and CO2
0.5 M LQ and Fc1N112-TFSI, and 1 M NaOTf in DEGME were employed

observations.quote: Quinones have been known to form adducts with CO2 in their reduced state via nucleophilic addition reactions for many years
even in the presence of O2, the LQ was able to capture CO2 and release all of that captured gas
